Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a) showing a massive right-sided opacity with leftward mediastinal shift to the post-operative image (Figure 1c), the mass has been removed and the right lung has re-expanded, but not completely (residual opacity/atelectasis remains). The heart and trachea remain shifted to the left or have not fully returned to midline, consistent with partial re-expansion and residual volume loss.
